Digital twin capstone: ingest your READMEs, design docs, eval reports, postmortems; RAG with citations (reuse AtlasAI’s retrieval service); FastAPI + React chat on your portfolio site.
defense/atlasai.md: 10 hard questions (chunking choice; hybrid lift; judge calibration; fabrication rate; multi-tenancy isolation; cost per answer; what failed).
Quiet Network: 1–2 genuine conversations with engineers from your target list (thoughtful comment or a question about their work; no pitch, no referral ask). Log in the tracker.

Weekly revision — Timed coding sessions (2 mediums / 45 min) ×3, Full 45-min system-design mock ×1, Project defense: architecture, failures, scale, cost, security, alternatives, Capstone: digital twin RAG over project docs: rewrite the key ideas from memory (no notes), then compare with your notes and fix the gaps. Reimplement two things from this week without looking.
